blocks.text: Uchala so'z ham vaqt haqida, lekin har biri boshqa savolga javob beradi. **for** — «qancha vaqt?» (muddat): for two years. **since** — «qachondan beri?» (boshlanish nuqtasi): since 2015. **ago** — «qancha vaqt oldin?»: two years ago. O'zbekchada **for** va **since** ikkalasi ham ko'pincha «**-dan beri**» bo'lib tarjima qilinadi (ikki yil**dan beri**, 2015-yil**dan beri**), **ago** esa — «**oldin**». Shuning uchun o'zbeklar for va since ni ko'p chalkashtiradi. 18-darsda ularni Present Perfect bilan ko'rdik; bu darsda farqlarini aniq ajratamiz.

**for** dan keyin **vaqt miqdori** keladi — nechta daqiqa, kun, yil: for ten minutes, for three days, for six months, for a long time, for ages. for har xil zamon bilan ishlatiladi: Present Perfect bilan — hozirgacha davom etayotgan muddat (I**'ve lived** here **for** ten years), Past Simple bilan — o'tmishda tugagan muddat (I **lived** in London **for** two years), Present Continuous bilan — reja (I**'m staying for** a week). all day, all week, all my life oldidan for qo'yilmaydi: «for all day» emas, **all day**.

items.text: We stayed in London **for** a week.

blocks.text: **since** dan keyin harakat **boshlangan payt** keladi: soat (since 8 o'clock), kun (since Monday), oy (since May), yil (since 2015), bayram yoki voqea (since Christmas, since the wedding), hatto butun gap (since I was a child, since we met). since bilan asosan **Present Perfect** ishlatiladi, chunki u «o'sha paytdan **hozirgacha**» degan ma'noni beradi. «I live here since 2015» — xato; to'g'risi: I**'ve lived** here **since** 2015.

O'zingizga savol bering: so'zda **son va o'lchov** bormi (ikki soat, besh yil, bir necha kun)? — **for**. So'z **taqvimdagi nuqtani** yoki voqeani bildiradimi (dushanba, may, 2015, to'y, bolalik)? — **since**. Bitta faktni ikki usulda aytish mumkin: hozir soat o'n bo'lsa, I've been waiting **for** two hours = I've been waiting **since** eight o'clock.

**ago** hozirgi paytdan orqaga sanaydi: ten minutes **ago**, two days **ago**, a year **ago**, a long time **ago**. U o'zbekchadagi «oldin» kabi vaqtdan **keyin** turadi: three years **ago** — uch yil oldin («ago three years» emas, «before three years» ham emas). ago aniq o'tgan vaqtni bildiradi, shuning uchun u bilan **Past Simple** ishlatiladi: I **met** her ten years ago. Present Perfect bilan ago kelmaydi: «I've met her ten years ago» — xato. Savol: **How long ago** did ...? — «Qancha vaqt oldin ...?», yoki **When** did ...?

rows: Aziz bu yerda uch yil oldin ishlay boshlagan.
U bu yerda uch yildan beri ishlaydi.

blocks.text: for Past Simple bilan kelsa, muddat **o'tmishda tugagan**: I **lived** in Moscow **for** five years (endi u yerda yashamayman). Present Perfect bilan esa muddat **hozir ham davom etyapti**: I**'ve lived** in Tashkent **for** five years (hali ham shu yerdaman). O'zbekchada bu farq qo'shimchada ko'rinadi: «besh yil yasha**gan**man» (tugagan) va «besh yil**dan beri** yasha**yman**» (davom etyapti).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I've lived here since five years.» → **for** five years.; «I'm here since Monday.» → I**'ve been** here since Monday.; «I have seen him two days ago.» → I **saw** him two days ago.; «I met her before ten years.» → ten years **ago**. («oldin» = ago, before emas); «ago two years» → two years **ago**; «I worked for all day.» → I worked **all day**.

Uch savol: «**Qancha vaqt?**» (son + o'lchov) → **for**; «**Qachondan beri?**» (sana, kun, voqea) → **since**; «**Qancha vaqt oldin?**» → **ago** + Past Simple. O'zbekcha: «ikki yil**dan beri**» → for; «2015-yil**dan beri**» → since; «ikki yil **oldin**» → ago.
since ... — «o'shandan beri»: **since then**. from ... to, until, since, for predlog sifatida — 104-dars; before / after — 105-dars; Present Perfect + how long — 18-dars.

examples.title: **for** + a period: for ten minutes, for two years
examples.description: for — «qancha vaqt?»: son va o'lchov (minutes, days, years). Har xil zamon bilan: hozirgacha (Present Perfect), tugagan (Past Simple), odat (Present Simple).

sentences.text: I**'ve worn** glasses **for** about ten years.
sentences.translation: **Taxminan o'n yildan beri** ko'zoynak **taqaman**.

sentences.text: Madina **has been** at the hairdresser's **for** two hours!
sentences.translation: Madina **ikki soatdan beri** sartaroshxonada **o'tiribdi**!

sentences.text: We **waited** for the bus **for** twenty minutes, and then we took a taxi.
sentences.translation: Avtobusni **yigirma daqiqa kutdik**, keyin taksiga o'tirdik.

sentences.text: Tom **lived** in Japan **for** three years when he was younger.
sentences.translation: Tom yoshligida **uch yil Yaponiyada yashagan**.

sentences.text: My uncle **is staying** with us **for** a week.
sentences.translation: Amakim bizga **bir haftaga mehmon bo'lib keldi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod and Dilnoza **have been** together **for** a long time.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bilan Dilnoza **anchadan beri birga**.

sentences.text: Every evening Grandad **walks** in the park **for** an hour.
sentences.translation: Bobom har kuni kechqurun parkda **bir soat sayr qiladi**.

sentences.text: The film was really long — it **lasted for** over three hours.
sentences.translation: Film juda uzun edi — **uch soatdan ko'proq davom etdi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **hasn't eaten** meat **for** five years.
sentences.translation: Sara **besh yildan beri go'sht yemaydi**.

sentences.text: After the operation, Aziz **was** in hospital **for** ten days.
sentences.translation: Operatsiyadan keyin Aziz **o'n kun kasalxonada yotdi**.

examples.title: **since** + a starting point: since Monday, since 2015
examples.description: since — «qachondan beri?»: soat, kun, oy, yil, voqea yoki butun gap (since I dropped it). Asosan Present Perfect bilan.

sentences.text: I**'ve had** a headache **since** this morning.
sentences.translation: **Ertalabdan beri boshim og'riyapti**.

sentences.text: Emma **has lived** in Oxford **since** 2018.
sentences.translation: Emma **2018-yildan beri** Oksfordda **yashaydi**.

sentences.text: We **haven't seen** our cousins **since** the wedding.
sentences.translation: To'ydan beri amakivachchalarimizni **ko'rganimiz yo'q**.

sentences.text: Aziz **has been** a vegetarian **since** he was sixteen.
sentences.translation: Aziz **o'n olti yoshidan beri** vegetarian.

sentences.text: It **has snowed** every day **since** Christmas.
sentences.translation: Rojdestvodan beri **har kuni qor yog'yapti**.

sentences.text: My phone **hasn't worked** properly **since** I dropped it.
sentences.translation: Telefonimni tushirib yuborganimdan beri u yaxshi **ishlamayapti**.

sentences.text: Tom **has been** much happier **since** he changed jobs.
sentences.translation: Tom ishini o'zgartirganidan beri ancha **xursand yuribdi**.

sentences.text: Madina and Bekzod **have known** each other **since** primary school.
sentences.translation: Madina bilan Bekzod bir-birini **boshlang'ich maktabdan beri taniydi**.

sentences.text: **Since** January, prices **have gone** up by ten per cent.
sentences.translation: **Yanvardan beri** narxlar o'n foizga **oshdi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **has been** in a bad mood **since** yesterday.
sentences.translation: Sara **kechadan beri** kayfiyati **yo'q**.

examples.title: **for** or **since**? The same fact, two ways
examples.description: Bitta fakt — ikki usul: for + muddat (olti yildan beri) yoki since + boshlanish nuqtasi (2020-yildan beri). Hozir 2026-yil deb hisoblang.

sentences.text: Bekzod **has worked** at the bank **for** six years.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bankda **olti yildan beri** ishlaydi.

sentences.text: In other words, he **has worked** there **since** 2020.
sentences.translation: Boshqacha aytganda, u u yerda **2020-yildan beri** ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Grandma **has been** in Samarkand **for** a week.
sentences.translation: Buvim **bir haftadan beri** Samarqandda.

sentences.text: She **has been** there **since** last Monday.
sentences.translation: U **o'tgan dushanbadan beri** o'sha yerda.

sentences.text: The children **have been** in the garden **for** half an hour.
sentences.translation: Bolalar **yarim soatdan beri** bog'da.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **has had** her car **since** her birthday in May.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning mashinasi **may oyidagi tug'ilgan kunidan beri** bor.

sentences.text: We**'ve known** James **for** ages — **since** we were students.
sentences.translation: Jeymsni **anchadan beri** taniymiz — **talabalik yillarimizdan beri**.

sentences.text: It**'s been raining** **for** three days — **since** Sunday!
sentences.translation: **Uch kundan beri** — **yakshanbadan beri** yomg'ir yog'yapti!

sentences.text: Madina **hasn't called** **for** a month — not **since** her trip to London.
sentences.translation: Madina **bir oydan beri** qo'ng'iroq qilmaydi — **London safaridan beri**.

sentences.text: My parents **have been** married **for** thirty-five years, **since** 1991.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam **1991-yildan beri**, ya'ni **o'ttiz besh yildan beri** birga.

examples.title: **ago** + Past Simple: five minutes ago, two years ago
examples.description: ago — hozirdan orqaga: «... oldin». Doim vaqtdan keyin turadi va Past Simple bilan keladi (Present Perfect emas).

sentences.text: The train **left** five minutes **ago**.
sentences.translation: Poyezd **besh daqiqa oldin** jo'nab ketdi.

sentences.text: I **met** my best friend twenty years **ago**.
sentences.translation: Eng yaqin do'stim bilan **yigirma yil oldin** tanishganman.

sentences.text: Aziz and Madina **got married** two years **ago**.
sentences.translation: Aziz bilan Madina **ikki yil oldin** turmush qurishgan.

sentences.text: My grandfather **built** this house a long time **ago**.
sentences.translation: Bobom bu uyni **ancha yillar oldin** qurgan.

sentences.text: Emma **arrived** in Tashkent three days **ago**, and she loves it already.
sentences.translation: Emma **uch kun oldin** Toshkentga keldi va shahar unga allaqachon yoqib qoldi.

sentences.text: Half an hour **ago** it **was** sunny, and now it's raining!
sentences.translation: **Yarim soat oldin** havo quyoshli edi, endi esa yomg'ir yog'yapti!

sentences.text: We **moved** to this flat about six months **ago**.
sentences.translation: Bu kvartiraga **taxminan olti oy oldin** ko'chib keldik.

sentences.text: Not long **ago**, nobody in our village **had** a computer.
sentences.translation: **Yaqin-yaqingacha** qishlog'imizda hech kimda kompyuter **yo'q edi**.

sentences.text: Tom **phoned** a minute **ago** — he's on his way.
sentences.translation: Tom **bir daqiqa oldin** qo'ng'iroq qildi — yo'lda ekan.

sentences.text: A hundred years **ago**, people **travelled** from Tashkent to Samarkand on horses and camels.
sentences.translation: **Yuz yil oldin** odamlar Toshkentdan Samarqandga ot va tuyada **qatnashardi**.

examples.title: How long **ago** ...? When **did** ...?
examples.description: ago bilan savol — Past Simple: How long ago did ...? («Qancha vaqt oldin?») yoki When did ...? («Qachon?»). Javob: ... ago.

sentences.text: How long **ago** did you start this job? — About a year **ago**.
sentences.translation: Bu ishni **qancha vaqt oldin boshlagansiz**? — Taxminan bir yil oldin.

sentences.text: When **did** Bekzod **buy** his car? — Three months **ago**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod mashinasini **qachon olgan**? — Uch oy oldin.

sentences.text: How long **ago** did your grandparents move to Tashkent?
sentences.translation: Bobo-buvingiz Toshkentga **qancha vaqt oldin ko'chib kelgan**?

sentences.text: Sarah, when **did** you last **see** Tom? — A few weeks **ago**, I think.
sentences.translation: Sara, Tomni **oxirgi marta qachon ko'rgansan**? — Bir necha hafta oldin, shekilli.

sentences.text: And when **did** the film **start**? — Ten minutes **ago**. You've missed the beginning!
sentences.translation: Film **qachon boshlandi**? — O'n daqiqa oldin. Boshini o'tkazib yubordingiz!

sentences.text: So how long **ago** did you finish university?
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, universitetni **qancha vaqt oldin tamomlagansiz**?

sentences.text: When **did** Madina **call**? — Just a moment **ago**, while you were in the shower.
sentences.translation: Madina **qachon qo'ng'iroq qildi**? — Hozirgina, siz dushda paytingizda.

sentences.text: Excuse me, how long **ago** did the last bus leave?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, oxirgi avtobus **qancha vaqt oldin ketdi**?

sentences.text: Dr Karimov, when **did** you **become** a doctor? — Fifteen years **ago**.
sentences.translation: Doktor Karimov, **qachon shifokor bo'lgansiz**? — O'n besh yil oldin.

sentences.text: The last big earthquake in Tashkent **happened** in 1966 — sixty years **ago**.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdagi so'nggi kuchli zilzila 1966-yilda — **oltmish yil oldin bo'lgan**.

examples.title: started ... **ago** → has ... **for** / **since**
examples.description: Bitta voqea ikki tomondan: ... ago (Past Simple — qachon boshlangan) va for / since then (Present Perfect — hozirgacha). **since then** — «o'shandan beri».

sentences.text: Dilnoza **started** learning the piano five years **ago**.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **besh yil oldin** pianino chalishni o'rgana boshlagan.

sentences.text: She **has played** the piano **for** five years now.
sentences.translation: U **besh yildan beri** pianino chaladi.

sentences.text: James **came** to Samarkand four months **ago**.
sentences.translation: Jeyms Samarqandga **to'rt oy oldin** kelgan.

sentences.text: He **has been** there **since** June, and he has learnt a lot of Uzbek.
sentences.translation: U **iyundan beri** o'sha yerda va ancha o'zbekcha o'rganib oldi.

sentences.text: We **bought** our flat in 2016 — ten years **ago**.
sentences.translation: Kvartiramizni 2016-yilda — **o'n yil oldin** sotib olganmiz.

sentences.text: So we**'ve had** it **for** ten years — **since** 2016.
sentences.translation: Demak, u bizda **o'n yildan beri** — **2016-yildan beri** bor.

sentences.text: Tom **got** ill a week **ago**, and he **hasn't been** to work **since** then.
sentences.translation: Tom **bir hafta oldin** kasal bo'lib qoldi va **o'shandan beri** ishga chiqmadi.

sentences.text: Aziz **joined** the gym three months **ago**, and he **has lost** five kilos **since** then.
sentences.translation: Aziz **uch oy oldin** sport zaliga yozildi va **o'shandan beri** besh kilo ozdi.

sentences.text: I last **saw** Madina at her wedding two years **ago**. I **haven't seen** her **since**.
sentences.translation: Madinani **oxirgi marta ikki yil oldin** to'yida ko'rganman. **O'shandan beri** ko'rmadim.

sentences.text: The café **opened** a month **ago**, and it **has been** full every day **since**.
sentences.translation: Kafe **bir oy oldin** ochildi va **o'shandan beri** har kuni odam bilan to'la.

examples.title: I **lived** there **for** ... / I**'ve lived** here **for** ...
examples.description: for + Past Simple — muddat o'tmishda tugagan; for + Present Perfect — hozir ham davom etyapti. O'zbekchada: «besh yil yashagan» va «ikki yildan beri yashaydi».

sentences.text: Aziz **lived** in Moscow **for** five years, but now he's back in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Aziz Moskvada **besh yil yashagan**, lekin hozir Toshkentga qaytgan.

sentences.text: He**'s lived** in Tashkent again **for** two years now.
sentences.translation: U **ikki yildan beri** yana Toshkentda **yashaydi**.

sentences.text: My mother **was** a teacher **for** thirty years. She retired last year.
sentences.translation: Oyim **o'ttiz yil o'qituvchi bo'lgan**. O'tgan yili nafaqaga chiqdi.

sentences.text: My aunt **has been** a teacher **for** thirty years, and she still loves her job.
sentences.translation: Xolam **o'ttiz yildan beri o'qituvchi**, hali ham ishini yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: We **waited** **for** an hour, and then we went home.
sentences.translation: Biz **bir soat kutdik**, keyin uyga ketdik.

sentences.text: We**'ve been waiting** **for** an hour, and he still isn't here!
sentences.translation: Biz **bir soatdan beri kutyapmiz**, u esa hali ham yo'q!

sentences.text: Sarah **studied** in London **for** four years, from 2015 to 2019.
sentences.translation: Sara 2015-yildan 2019-yilgacha, ya'ni **to'rt yil Londonda o'qigan**.

sentences.text: Emma **has studied** Uzbek **for** two years, and she speaks it quite well.
sentences.translation: Emma **ikki yildan beri** o'zbek tilini **o'rganadi**, ancha yaxshi gapiradi.

sentences.text: Bekzod **didn't smoke** **for** a month, but then he started again.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **bir oy chekmadi**, lekin keyin yana boshladi.

sentences.text: Bekzod's father **hasn't smoked** **for** twenty years.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning otasi **yigirma yildan beri chekmaydi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: a job interview
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: for, since, ago va ular bilan keladigan zamonlar — ishga qabul suhbatida.

sentences.text: — So, Mr Aliyev, how long **have** you **worked** as a programmer?
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, janob Aliyev, **qancha vaqtdan beri dasturchi bo'lib ishlaysiz**?

sentences.text: — **For** about seven years. I **started** my first job seven years **ago**.
sentences.translation: — **Taxminan yetti yildan beri**. Birinchi ishimni **yetti yil oldin** boshlaganman.

sentences.text: — And how long **have** you **been** at your present company?
sentences.translation: — Hozirgi kompaniyangizda-chi, **qachondan beri ishlaysiz**?

sentences.text: — **Since** 2022. Before that I **worked** in a small firm in Samarkand **for** three years.
sentences.translation: — **2022-yildan beri**. Undan oldin Samarqanddagi kichik firmada **uch yil ishlaganman**.

sentences.text: — I see. When **did** you **finish** university?
sentences.translation: — Tushunarli. Universitetni **qachon tamomlagansiz**?

sentences.text: — Eight years **ago**, in 2018.
sentences.translation: — **Sakkiz yil oldin**, 2018-yilda.

sentences.text: — **Have** you **studied** English **since** then?
sentences.translation: — **O'shandan beri** ingliz tilini **o'rganyapsizmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, I**'ve had** lessons twice a week **for** the last two years.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **so'nggi ikki yildan beri** haftasiga ikki marta dars olaman.

sentences.text: — Good. One last question: how long **have** you **lived** in Tashkent?
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi. So'nggi savol: Toshkentda **qachondan beri yashaysiz**?

sentences.text: — Only **for** a few months. My family **moved** here in the summer.
sentences.translation: — **Bir necha oydan beri**, xolos. Oilam bu yerga yozda **ko'chib kelgan**.
